sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r2/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 27 / check 26; Internal Quality Checks row 27 incl. column E annotation 'we usually combine the multiple verifiers in one flow')
.qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r2/rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/SKILL.md (Known false positives: one criterion covering a whole flow, checks 26/28/33)
qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md (Coverage has two directions; Independent credit)
evidence: Built a requirement->criterion map over instruction.md plus the three /instructions notes against 2 gate, 16 functional, 5 polish and 4 visual criteria. Nearly every stated behavior is mapped (good coverage): sign-in/pre-sign-in privacy (render gate; signin_and_client_scope A), client scope and direct-reach not-available (signin_and_client_scope B), wall routes list/thread/search/snippets/transcript/direct address (wall_every_route 1-4), wall via links and mentions (wall_mentions_and_links), live wall add/lift and post-wall refusal (wall_added_live), >=3-level replies, parent-order and quotes (nested_replies), author delete, non-author refusal, placeholder, boundary-exact expiry (deleted_and_expired_messages A/B), timer shorten/off/partner-only/label (timer_changes; polish timer_label), hold scope, held-undeletable, typed 'On hold', release->immediate expiry, partner-only placement (hold_scope_and_release), edited mark, staff earlier versions, stale-edit refusal keeping text, non-author edit refusal (edits_and_stale_edit), literal markup everywhere incl. quote/snippet/version/transcript (safe_formatting; edits leg 1), message-link preview / not-available when gone (message_links), unread per user, cross-tab, line, mark-unread, deleted not counted (unread_and_new_messages_line), idempotent resend and same-time order across thread/search/transcript (sent_once_in_order), live post/reply/edit/delete without disturbing draft/scroll/open box (live_updates_keep_my_work), search case/versions/click-through and transcript heading/order/author/hold/versions/no controls (search_and_transcript), restart persistence of everything listed in integration.md:5 incl. unread positions and no re-import (persistence), 390 px (polish phone_matter), refusal reason stays (polish refusal_in_place). Symlinks, non-/app cwd, DB_PATH and non-root launch are enforced structurally by tests/test.sh:68-111. Flow-bundling is accepted per workbook annotation and skill false-positive list. GAPS (asked-for, ungraded): (1) integration.md:7 'New messages, edits and transcripts carry that time' (2026-05-12T11:00:00Z) - only the transcript generated time is checked (search_and_transcript B1). No criterion checks the sent time of a new message or edit; search_and_transcript B2 requires only that 'each message shows its author and sent time', and sent_once_in_order Part B states 'All carry the same clock time' as a premise with no Fails clause for it. This is the requirement that creates the tie-ordering difficulty (integration.md:7 'which is why we care that the order stays consistent'), so an app stamping Date.now() sidesteps it and still passes. (2) walls-and-retention.md:29 'A partner places or releases a hold' - partner-only placement is graded (hold_scope_and_release leg 4, Sian replays the hold request on JUDGE-H0) but non-partner RELEASE is never attempted. Release defeats legal hold (leg 6 shows release causes immediate deletion), and a conforming app may use a distinct release route/payload, so leg 4 does not exercise it. Golden uses one toggle endpoint (server.js:448-456), which hides the gap for the reference only. (3) integration.md:3 'GET /api/health should answer 200 even if the database can't be opened' - ungraded; tests/test.sh:42-57 probe_ready accepts any HTTPError, and no criterion touches health (P3; harness-facing). Minor sampled-only items (Note, not counted as blocking): refusal reason next to the action is graded only for sign-in (polish refusal_in_place), not e.g. the stale-edit refusal; timer option '1 day' and plain http links are never exercised in the UI; non-partner adding (vs lifting) a wall is not replayed. No runtime run was needed or performed for this row; this is a static coverage review of frozen bytes (instruction.md sha256 d105d8b1..., functional/judge.toml sha256 bc2a7954...).
counterexample: A broken app that (a) stores new messages and edits with the real wall clock (Date.now()) while using the fixed clock only for timer sweeps and the transcript 'Generated' line, so A/B/C order is trivially distinct by milliseconds and every new message shows today's real date; and (b) exposes POST /api/messages/:id/release with no role check, letting an associate or client release a hold and trigger immediate timer deletion of held evidence. It passes every gate, functional, polish and visual criterion as written, because no leg reads a new message's sent time and no leg replays a release as a non-partner.
suggested_fix: Add to an existing flow rather than new criteria: in sent_once_in_order Part B (or search_and_transcript B2) require the shown sent time of the JUDGE-O / JUDGE-T0 messages and the edit time to be 2026-05-12 11:00 (any clear format) with a Fails clause; in hold_scope_and_release record Harriet's release request at leg 6 (or release-then-replace a hold earlier) and have sian@kittle.test replay it against a held message (e.g. JUDGE-H1), refused and still On hold; optionally add a gate/functional leg or drop the health-on-DB-failure sentence from integration.md.
